runtime_profile.notes: CPU-only PyTorch installed for testing. CUDA extensions require GPU hardware and are skipped with BUILD_CUDA_EXT=0. Marlin kernel tests require NVIDIA GPU with compute capability 8.0+.

notes: AutoGPTQ is an LLM quantization library. The environment uses CPU-only PyTorch for basic testing since no GPU is available. Marlin kernel tests (TestsQ4Marlin) require CUDA GPU with compute capability 8.0+ (Ampere). The fix adds marlin_utils.py for persisting and reloading Marlin-format quantized models. git and curl are included in system packages. The test runner (pytest) is reachable and can collect tests.
